notes: The first branch (عبدة ← يحيى بن آدم) stops at يحيى بن آدم: the text writes no further names for it, so it is not extended to the Companion.
«قال نبئت عن» is a transmission verb; يحيى بن زكريا is the next link.
«وقال عمرو إن رسول الله» is a wording variant (the Prophet's name in place of «النبي»); left out.
